zones.name: Haven
zones.note: Central hub area; western part explored after obtaining Bell Tower Visitor Pass

zones.name: Bell Tower
zones.note: Located in Haven's western region; requires Visitor Pass to access

zones.name: Metropolis
zones.note: A once-proud robot city; destination after defeating Crow

zones.name: Hall of History
zones.note: Located in Metropolis; contains elevator leading below the city

zones.name: Foundations
zones.note: Area below Metropolis, accessible via elevator in Hall of History; site of The Blood

zones.name: Promenade
zones.note: Area west of Haven across a dark chasm; requires Glide ability to reach

zones.name: The Vaults
zones.note: Located underneath Haven; contains The Hand; directed to by Shii after severing both Breath and Blood

zones.name: The Lab
zones.note: Area revisited after Vaults; site of final confrontation with The Hand / Dr. Halyn

abilities.name: Bell Tower Visitor Pass

abilities.name: Glide
abilities.note: Unlocked before Part 6; required to venture across the dark chasm west of Haven

bosses.name: Crow
bosses.note: Already defeated by start of this segment; dropping the Harvester on defeat

bosses.name: The Hand
bosses.note: Identified as Dr. Halyn; Pearl boss; final confrontation in Part 11

bosses.name: The Spine
